# Loci normal graph retrieval: actual-host activation and frozen adoption result

On 14 September 2026, after Vik restarted Codex, the actual loaded catalog exposed only loci_retrieve and loci_read. Primary and fresh-delegate native retrieve/read receipts validated exact source and wire bytes, complete static proof and full_exact model delivery. Implementation90068fa, host/accounting006923b and pre-outcome freeze8ef9b4d are published in Phluxxed/loci. The versioned normal-v2/native-v2 accounting corrections were checked with58 directly relevant tests; historical suite failures remain qualified in the delivery report.

All ten reserved post observations completed: eight fresh Terra/high ordinary delegates and two separate known-answer primary checks. No task reminders, replacements or additional trial batches ran. All eight invoked Loci (baseline4/8); six had at least one validated positive full_exact graph delivery (baseline2/8). This includes only2/4 binding/browser rows, below the frozen3/4 requirement. The all-required-facts gate also fails. Complete delivery alone does not establish relevance or internal reliance.

The browser primary check returned main -> runBrowserCli with complete import/re-export proof and full_exact delivery. The binding primary returned selected source and other graph relationships but did not return the CaptureCommandResultOptions -> WorkContextBinding identity relationship in its three retained query/anchor continuations. Thus1/2 primary expected-proof checks pass. Fixed selection and output-budget omissions remain visible; no product repair or re-run occurred after freeze.

Frozen cost gates fail: checkpoint median elapsed1.543x baseline; binding visiblebytes1.282x, provider inputtokens2.724x and elapsed1.497x; browser inputtokens1.329x. Renderer medians improve on all three measures. Token figures include cached input and do not establish dollar cost. There is no aggregate efficiency or acceptance claim.

W1.8.3 records the completed measurement with a negative disposition. W1.8.4 and the Objective remain open because useful required-context delivery and the agreed correctness/cost acceptance are unresolved. Keep the frozen evidence; any further implementation must address those measured gaps, and no new provider batch is implied by this closeout.

Limitations: selected small workload, source/instruction/runtime intervention rather than graph-only causal attribution; no population or cognition claim. Child NEW_TASK payloads are encrypted: exact parent spawn submissions are attested, not independently plaintext-hash verified. All638 frozen source files/no-extra-file identities were checked; original archive bytes were unavailable. Native upstream silent omissions and opaque shell activity remain unknown. Parent compaction prevents whole-turn primary accounting; individual original native calls use unchanged frozen correlation/proof helpers, with no fabricated completion or per-case provider cost. Private Claude/work-repository evidence remains outside scope.

Evidence: /Users/brummerv/loci/docs/reviews/2026-09-14-normal-graph-host-activation.md; /Users/brummerv/loci/benchmarks/comparisons/ordinary-adoption-normal-v1/{freeze,results}.json; /Users/brummerv/loci/docs/reviews/2026-09-14-normal-graph-adoption-result.md; canonical Manifest Objective obj_47c29425d32907d2bde961f1fd313970.
